rationale: The agent unilaterally modified the order and issued a refund without first confirming the change with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While the provided tool list suggests the agent could have authenticated and checked the order, the conversation shows no explicit confirmation step or explicit verification of “same or lower” price prior to the change; the agent only reported the new price and refund after acting. The statement that the order cannot be modified or cancelled further is also not supported by visible tool results. Therefore, despite achieving the requested item/color and price reduction, the lack of pre-change confirmation causes the interaction to fail the policy-compliance bar.
